shared_elements: more than one figure placed side by side
justification: Both depict human-like faces and more than one figure set adjacent to one another, which is about as generic as figural imagery gets. A is a flat, densely carved narrative panel of elaborately costumed profile figures with scroll motifs and horizontal registers of sign-like marks, while B is a blocky, three-dimensional pair of near-featureless heads with only brow and eye masses indicated — no costume, no scene, no registers, and no shared conventions of rendering.
